kurz: Water in the dough turns to steam in a hot oven and puffs up hollow spaces. Puff pastry and cream puffs rise without any baking powder.
bild_im_kopf: Like a popcorn kernel: the water inside turns to steam and bursts it open.
was_passiert: Water expands enormously as it turns to steam. In puff pastry it sits in thin layers of [[butter|butter]] and dough, and the steam pushes the layers apart. In [[brandteig|choux]] pastry a shell forms, which the steam blows up like a balloon.
warum_wichtig: Explains why these pastries must be baked very hot and why cream puffs collapse if you open the oven too early.
faustregeln: Start very hot, so a lot of steam forms quickly.
Keep puff pastry cold, so the butter layers stay separate.
Open the oven only once the pastry is firm and browned.
